name: Imperial Harem
original_name: インペリアルハーレム
source:
You're a government official in the empire and, with the emperor's illness, you've decided now is your chance to wrest control of the nation for yourself.
However, the emperor's lone daughter Tiana and her closest aides pose the largest threat to you. They want a pure and proper government, and wish to purge the tainted likes of people like you.
But you've just acquired a special ring that can turn the tides in your favor...

The fiery beast-girl maid Aruru.
The devoted researcher and alchemist Fii.
The beautiful and prideful princess Tiana.

All must fall to the pleasure of your probing fingers. Corrupt them in body and mind, and the empire is yours.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ286695.html/?locale=en_US]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
你是帝国的一名政府官员，随着皇帝的生病，你决定现在是你自己夺取国家控制权的机会。
然而，皇帝的独生女蒂安娜和她最亲密的助手对你构成了最大的威胁。他们想要一个清正廉洁的政府，希望清除像你这样的污点。
但你刚刚获得了一枚特殊的戒指，它可以扭转局势，对你有利……

火热的兽系女仆阿鲁鲁。
虔诚的研究员兼炼金术士菲尔。
美丽而骄傲的蒂安娜公主。

一切都必须由你的手指探索的乐趣所决定。腐蚀他们的身心，帝国就是你的了。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ286695.html/?locale=en_US]DLSite[/url]]
